description: arXiv:2609.13661v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Knowledge graph question answering usually assumes that one system can reach the whole graph. In practice, facts are often held by organizations that share entity identifiers but own disjoint relation types, so no single party sees a complete reasoning chain. This poster presents the empirical findings of FedV-KGQA on multi-hop question answering...
author: Md Saikat Islam Khan Bappy, Oshani Seneviratne
